name: BRITISH AMERDRN
summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. provides tobacco and nicotine products to consumers worldwide, including vapour products, heated products, modern oral nicotine pouches, and combustibles, under brands such as Vuse, glo, Velo, Dunhill, Kent, Lucky Strike, and Camel. Founded in 1902, headquartered in London, United Kingdom. This row represents the company's Brazilian Depositary Receipt (BDR).
